note: WAEC Government round 6 (R33 top-up): 1922 elective seats for Lagos and Calabar; Willink Commission; Balewa first Prime Minister; Shagari first executive president; Second Republic 1979-1983; Murtala Mohammed assassinated 1976; Aba Women's Riot 1929; Are-Ona-Kakanfo of Oyo; Kanem-Bornu; Benin's Oba; Hausa city-state sarauta; Chief Justice at the head; judicial precedent; Sharia Court of Appeal; Privy Council before 1963; Senate President presiding; a senator's four years; the committee stage clause by clause; overriding a veto by two-thirds; collective responsibility; the shadow cabinet; vote of no confidence; run-off and by-elections; occupational against promotional groups; the chief whip; godfatherism; the ombudsman; totalitarianism; the republic defined; RMAFC and revenue sharing; Ministry of Foreign Affairs; ECOMOG peacekeeping; the ICJ at The Hague; UNICEF for children. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-5, NECO Government (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
